title: polystichum walkerae
intro: Polystichum walkerae, commonly known as Himalayan silver fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the Dryopteridaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Polystichum walkerae include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and anti-cancer effects. Furthermore, Polystichum walkerae is also used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory problems.
